source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "housing platforms" OR "rental platforms" OR "digital housing" OR "platform real estate" OR "digital landlord"
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"housing platforms" OR "rental platforms" OR "digital housing" OR "platform real estate" OR "digital landlord",is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("digital housing" OR "digital landlord" OR "housing platforms" OR "platform real estate" OR "rental platforms")
